transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care, my name is Oscar. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Oscar. I was violently mugged an hour ago on Las Ramblas in Barcelona! A thief snatched my handbag containing my iPhone 15 Pro Max, my UK passport, and my bank cards! I am calling from the hotel reception phone in tears, and I need my phone completely blocked before criminals access my mobile banking apps!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What is the telephone number of the stolen mobile device, Aria?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mobile number is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero eight three nine, and the handset IMEI is three five eight two nine one, zero nine four eight two one, six.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me open your subscriber record and mobile IMEI serial registry on our cellular network core.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please bar the SIM card immediately so they don't rack up roaming call charges to premium international numbers.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me examine the central subscriber database to execute an immediate network suspension.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you see if any mobile data or calls were made after the phone was snatched?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you already initiated an emergency remote lock or device erase through Apple iCloud Find My?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the hotel concierge helped me log into iCloud on their laptop and I put the iPhone into Lost Mode with an immediate remote erase command.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did the Spanish local police provide you with a formal crime report reference number for the robbery?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the Mossos d'Esquadra police at the Plaça de Catalunya station gave me a formal denuncia crime report reference number: BAR-88902-ESP.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am going to trigger an emergency international network bar across all UK and European roaming partner networks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are you still there on the line, Oscar?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes Aria, apologies for the pause. The SIM card zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero eight three nine is now completely barred from all outgoing and incoming voice, SMS, and cellular data roaming.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank heavens for that, so they cannot use my SIM for two-factor banking codes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Any cellular connection attempting to authenticate with that IMSI receives an immediate reject code from international cellular towers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now can you blacklist the physical iPhone IMEI serial number so the phone itself becomes an unusable brick?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me query the Central Equipment Identity Register to initiate an international IMEI blacklist broadcast.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello, Oscar, did the international connection drop?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes Aria, apologies for the delay. The international IMEI blacklist has been transmitted to the GSMA global equipment database.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the GSMA blacklist prevent the thief from using the phone with a local Spanish or European SIM card?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the handset hardware IMEI is permanently barred from registering on any cellular network across one hundred and forty countries.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That ensures the stolen phone has zero resale value on the black market.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The hardware cannot authenticate even if the device firmware is completely wiped or factory reset.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does Apple iCloud Activation Lock remain active on the device after the remote erase command?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, Apple Activation Lock is permanently linked to your Apple ID on Apple's cloud activation servers, rendering the logic board unusable without your password.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will stop the criminals from bypassing the lock screen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you confirm whether any unauthorized calls or roaming data sessions registered on your account between the robbery and the SIM block?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I was mugged at twelve-thirty, so about an hour ago.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Checking our live CDR data mediation records... zero call activity or data usage occurred between twelve-thirty and one-thirty.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank goodness they didn't manage to place expensive international phone calls before you locked the line.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your account balance remains completely unaffected by fraudulent roaming charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will the Spanish police report reference BAR-88902-ESP be linked permanently to this IMEI docket?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the Mossos d'Esquadra crime reference number is logged on the GSMA global database incident report.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will provide an international audit trail for Interpol and UK authorities.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also locked your customer billing profile to prevent any unauthorized SIM replacement attempts at retail stores.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That closes off any fraudulent SIM-swap attempts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The Spanish police officer stamped my temporary theft report so the British consulate can verify the robbery case.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The official municipal police stamp satisfies our consular identification validation requirements.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I need official proof of blacklisting and SIM barring right now so I can claim an emergency replacement phone under my travel insurance policy.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Proof of barring can only be generated as an official physical paper document dispatched by standard Royal Mail second-class post to your registered UK home address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dispatched by second-class post to my UK house fifty miles from London?! I am stranded in Spain! The British consulate needs my mobile IMEI proof to verify my identity, and the airline needs proof to issue an emergency boarding pass today! How on earth can you tell me ten days by second class post?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Standard postal verification letters cannot be dispatched to international hotel addresses or foreign consular offices under our systems.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why can't you simply generate a PDF letter on S-Net letterhead and email it directly to my registered email address right now?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Company security regulations restrict digital transmission of proof-of-barring certificates due to fraudulent insurance claim risks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is utterly bureaucratic madness! I have the official Spanish police report number, I am stranded in a foreign country without money or a passport, and you refuse to send an email?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can submit a specialized manual request to our underwriting compliance desk to authorize an encrypted PDF email release.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do that! How long will the manual compliance authorization take?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The compliance supervisor can review the police report reference and dispatch an encrypted PDF certificate to your email within two hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Two hours is manageable, the hotel concierge will let me sit in the lobby until the email arrives.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will attach Spanish police report BAR-88902-ESP to expedite the compliance officer's approval. Just to confirm what you mentioned earlier, the handset IMEI is three five eight two nine one, zero nine four eight two one, six?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, three five eight two nine one, zero nine four eight two one, six.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The IMEI matches our register for your iPhone 15 Pro Max. I have also suspended your monthly line rental charges while you are traveling under docket reference SEC-44910-B.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Suspending the line rental and logging the docket is very fair and appreciated, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When you return to the UK, you can visit any S-Net retail high street store with photo ID to collect a free replacement SIM card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will go straight to the high street store once I land at Gatwick.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: How is your overall account standing otherwise on our network?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My S-Net mobile account has always had excellent 5G coverage across the UK, it was purely this violent mugging in Barcelona that caused such a nightmare.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We are very relieved that you are physically safe following such an awful street incident. I have verified that the SIM is barred, the IMEI is blacklisted on the global GSMA database, the expedited PDF certificate is queued, and line rental is paused. Does that cover everything for you today, Aria?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes Oscar, you've barred the phone and the email certificate will save my insurance claim. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net today, Aria. Please stay safe and have a safe journey back to the UK. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Oscar, goodbye.
